headline: Deadlands and Eastern Fronts See Renewed Action
war_summary: Since the previous edition, the ledger has sharpened markedly on several fronts, though the war remains without a victor on its eleventh day. Deadlands now records four strategic-base events in the latest two hours and nine over 24 hours, with casualty and enlistment rates accelerating sharply; its bases stand divided eight to three between Wardens and Colonials. Endless Shore remains the busiest theatre, rising to 37 events in the day and three in the latest two hours, with captures, neutralizations, and reversals all present. Drowned Vale retains 20 events across the day, but none in the latest two hours as its casualty and enlistment pace cools over two-hour comparisons. Farranac Coast has 18 events, while its recent six-hour record shows activity without a fresh two-hour change. Palantine Berm has four events in two hours and 14 in the day, and Stlican Shelf has two and 13 respectively. Clahstra’s eight daily events accompany an extraordinary surge in casualties and enlistments, though no base event is recorded in the latest two-hour window.
